content.text: Finding submitted: the Agreement has no insurance clause (confirmed by search and by reading §§ 5.3, 14.12 and 14.18), which is unacceptable for a hosting vendor processing Customer data. I proposed inserting a new Section 14.12A "Insurance" at the preferred limits (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' comp, certificates on request), with the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback noted as a negotiating position.
